name: Form
description: A native form that lays out its fields with the field gap and ends with an actions row. Livewire submits it with wire:submit; React and Vue with the native submit event.

props.name: actions
props.description: The buttons at the end of the form, such as Cancel and Save, aligned to the end.

props.name: divided
props.description: Separates the actions row with an edge above it. Emitted as data-divided.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { actions: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The native form; the default slot holds the fields. Attributes (wire:submit, action, method, novalidate) land here.

parts.name: actions
parts.description: The button row at the end.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: The buttons at the end of the form.

requirements: A native form, so Enter in a field submits it and the browser's validation runs unless novalidate is set.
Name the form (aria-label or aria-labelledby) when a page has more than one; a named form is a landmark.
The primary action comes last in the actions row and is a submit button.
Put a ValidationSummary at the top after a failed submit, and keep each field's own error.
